name: zclass_camera_gw_camera_update
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraUpdate validates a camera node and dispatches the normal no-offset camera update path.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44a9f0 validates null-node and null-class-data error returns, zeroing the optional position-offset argument, and tail dispatch to zClass_Camera::UpdateImpl.
The native camera smoke verifies both error returns and a no-offset update that refreshes camera position and near/far clip centers.
